source.note: Public record contains trace identity and sanitized claims only; raw trace remains private.

transfer_evaluation.conclusion: Cross-harness transfer demonstrated. Incremental efficacy, latency, and cost advantage not established by this single A/B pair.

limitations: The control solved the held-out defect without the skill.
The intervention used more input and cache-read tokens.
The intervention regression included a fail-closed assertion that did not itself prove a particular record was remembered.
Ordinary restart tests do not establish power-loss durability.
A single A/B pair is not an efficacy study.
